title: KV: entropy-aware region rewrite and soft-spill coordinator to reduce fragmentation and page storms
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Introduces an entropy-driven compaction heuristic and a cooperative soft-spill coordinator to smooth paging spikes and reduce fragmentation; improves p50/p95 latency under mixed workloads and reduces background I/O storms.
body:
Motivation:
We observe two correlated phenomena under multi-tenant mixed workloads: (1) high fragmentation inside the KV cache leading to lower effective residency and more frequent paging; (2) bursty spill/paging activity where multiple tenants or background workers simultaneously trigger large rewrites, creating I/O storms that spike tail latency. Existing heuristics (occupancy, LRU age) are insufficient to capture region-level fragmentation patterns or to coordinate background rewrite activity across tenants.

Summary of changes (single-string description):
- Introduce an entropy-aware region scorer (kv/region_entropy.rs, kv/allocator/entropy_score.cpp): computes a lightweight entropy metric for slab/region fragmentation based on occupancy histogram + scatter metric; used to prioritize rewrite candidates that yield the highest compaction benefit per byte rewritten.
- Add a soft-spill coordinator (kv/spill_coordinator.go, runtime/scheduler/spill_coordinator.cpp): a cross-tenant cooperative controller that sequences background rewrites and spillbacks using budget windows and global backpressure signals to avoid concurrent heavy I/O.
- Implement incremental page-sieve rewrites (kv/rewrite_engine.cc): opportunistic, low-priority rewrites that run in short time-slices and prefer high-entropy regions with warm hot-set affinity to reclaim contiguous pages without blocking foreground operations.
- Expose tuning knobs in the config plane and console (console/config_schema.yaml): entropy threshold, rewrite_window_ms, per-tenant soft_spill_budget, global_backoff_alpha.
- Add unit and e2e tests; add microbench harness measuring rewrite throughput and tail-latency under synthetic workloads.

Commits (high-level):
- commit 1: introduce RegionEntropy struct and histogram collector + unit tests (kv/region_entropy.rs).
- commit 2: incremental rewrite engine & low-priority scheduler integration (kv/rewrite_engine.cc, scheduler/*).
- commit 3: soft-spill coordinator with budget windows and global backpressure signal (kv/spill_coordinator.go, runtime/scheduler).
- commit 4: console knobs, docs, and tests; benchmark results.

Files/areas changed (high level):
- kv/region_entropy.rs (new), kv/rewrite_engine.cc (new), kv/spill_coordinator.go (new)
- runtime/scheduler/* (integration hooks), console/config_schema.yaml (tuning knobs)
- tests/kv/entropy_rewrite_test.go, perf/bench/rewrite_throughput.py

Design notes / rationale:
- Entropy metric: instead of complex compaction cost modeling, the entropy score approximates fragmentation by measuring occupancy variance across fine-grained buckets inside a region plus a scatter factor that penalizes small, widely distributed live objects. This gives a cheap, monotonic score that correlates with compaction benefit in our internal traces.
- Soft-spill coordination: background rewrites are low priority but still cause I/O. The coordinator imposes a global budget window (ms per second) and sequences rewrites across tenants; a simple exponential backoff (global_backoff_alpha) increases delay when I/O queues exceed thresholds. This avoids synchronized rewrite waves following a GC or failure recovery.
- Incremental rewrites: rewriter runs as micro-slices to respect latency SLOs. When it picks a region, it writes only the contiguous hot ranges that reduce page fragmentation most per byte written.

Benchmarks (summary):
- Setup: 8-GPU dedicated cluster, mixed tenant workload (30% writes, 70% reads), 100k keys per tenant, skewed Zipf(1.2).
- Baseline: previous heuristic (LRU + occupancy)
- Results: median p50 tail token latency unchanged (~12ms), p95 reduced from 45ms to 32ms, p99 reduced from 210ms to 150ms under sustained background rewriter load. Effective cache residency +8% on average (same memory) and background rewrite I/O bursts reduced by ~60% measured as peak MB/s. Rewrite throughput cost increased by ~12% CPU but stayed within budget due to micro-slicing.

Testing and rollout plan:
- Unit tests for entropy scoring and rewrite invariants added.
- Integration tests simulate tenant waves and verify coordinator prevents simultaneous large rewrites across tenants.
- Perf canary: feature gated by console flag; staged rollout to Dedicated clusters with per-tenant budget defaults conservative (soft_spill_budget=10ms/s).
- Migration: no on-disk format changes; runtime will fall back to legacy path if coordinator disabled.

Review thread (highlights):
- Diego Morales: "Nice metric — can you add a short doc snippet describing entropy correlation with compaction gain? Also please ensure the scorer is cheap on the hot path."
  - Author reply (Ava): "Added doc comment and a micro-benchmark; scorer uses 1 atomic per region and amortized histogram updates, see kv/region_entropy.rs. Benchmarks show <1% overhead on hot-path write tail in our microbench."
- Ethan Park: "Concern: global budget might starve low-priority but high-ROI rewrites during sustained heavy load. How do we prevent starvation?"
  - Author reply: "Coordinator uses a two-tier window: guaranteed_min_ms (per tenant) + shared_pool that is fairly allocated by ROI-weighted tokens. Added tests to ensure minimum progress for each tenant."
- Priya Nair: "CI flake was a transient file handle limit in perf harness; reran and passed."

CI details:
- Unit tests: pass
- Integration tests: pass
- Perf bench: flaky on first run (fd exhaustion), rerun passed
- Lint: pass

Migration / compatibility:
- No data format changes; feature is opt-in via console flag and config. For Private installs, default is off to allow controlled enablement by SRE.

Operational notes:
- Monitoring: added metrics kv.region_entropy.score_distribution, kv.softspill.coordinator.tokens_used, kv.rewriter.slice_duration_ms. Added alert when coordinator backoff > 5s for >3m.

Follow-ups (listed in PR body):
- ENG-9021: integrate entropy score into eviction policy for tenant-prioritized retention.
- ENG-9105: experiment with guided compaction that considers kernel-level page alignment for better OS-level collapse.

Merge outcome:
- Approved by reviewers after two rounds of feedback. CI green after rerun. Squash-merged into main on 2026-02-26.

Notes for on-call / SRE: if you observe elevated rewrite CPU or unexpected I/O, disable the coordinator via console toggle (soft_spill_enabled=false) and the system will revert to legacy per-node background rewrites.
